kind: Independent inclined-column native BRACE qualification within observed first-order 6DOF frame domain
scope: BEAM/COLUMN/BRACE SDK and FFRC valid rows crosschecked. BRACE IsBraceTruss=0, unreleased/zero offsets, actual AXD2 rows. No arbitrary internal station, other BRACE subtype, offset or nonlinear qualification. MM079 original col-special-01 remains historically input-gate rejected; this review binds only new col-special-01b and proves two benign degree-2 beam subdivisions.

diagramConvention.transform: physical endpoint match; global wrench=blockdiag(Rn.T,Rn.T)*Dn*h; source ACTIONS=Ds*blockdiag(Rs,Rs)*global wrench

assumptions: Linear elastic, small-displacement Timoshenko bending with explicit effective shear areas.
Shear areas are caller-supplied diagnostics; no native-input qualification or corpus promotion is implied.
Only nodal/point and piecewise-constant distributed loads are supported in finite-shear mode.
EB and Timoshenko displacements can differ physically; request tolerances are not adjusted.
No mass is added by observation/load subdivision; this solver performs static analysis only.
Commercial-engine comparisons are diagnostic, not same-engine native truth.
